svg.text: Arduino Uno + 1.28” round GC9A01 display, plus optional button and LED
power + data for the OrbDash app
LED: D3, 220 Ω resistor, LED, GND
The Uno's pins are 5 V. Most GC9A01 boards have a 3.3 V
regulator and accept this. If yours is 3.3 V only, power it
from 3.3V and put a level shifter on SCL, SDA, DC, CS, RST.
